meta.title: Asturias eclipse long-tail war game
meta.planningOrigin: Soto del Barco town-centre routing reference
meta.warning: Scenarios overlap and their probabilities must not be added. Empirical weather frequencies describe the historical sample; ordinal traffic bands are uncalibrated conditional planning judgments, not forecasts.

probabilityKinds.name: Empirical
probabilityKinds.definition: Measured frequency in the declared historical CERRA sample. The denominator is shown.

probabilityKinds.name: Live-only
probabilityKinds.definition: No defensible prior rate. Evaluate only from timestamped forecast, satellite, camera or direct observations.

probabilityKinds.name: Known condition
probabilityKinds.definition: A current or branch-dependent fact, such as missing parking data or shuttle-only access; not a frequency.

probabilityKinds.name: Heuristic
probabilityKinds.definition: Uncalibrated structured judgment used for planning. It is qualitative unless an explicit empirical denominator is supplied.

historicalFindings.title: The local historical split
historicalFindings.headline: 37.7% clear · 41.5% partial · 20.8% overcast
historicalFindings.detail: At the Soto/airport-area CERRA cell, 226 of 600 cases were clear/light, 249 were 21–79% cloud, and 125 were overcast.

historicalFindings.title: Coast-hopping can help in broken cloud
historicalFindings.headline: 42.6% any sampled coast · 17.3% nearby pair
historicalFindings.detail: When Soto was partly cloudy, at least one other sampled coastal cell was clear in 106 of 249 cases. Restricting the test to nearby Vidio or Peñas cut that to 43 of 249. A move still needs a broad observed gap.

historicalFindings.title: Deep overcast defeats coastal roulette
historicalFindings.headline: 8.0% any sampled coast · 0.8% nearby pair
historicalFindings.detail: When Soto was overcast, any other sampled coastal cell was clear in only 10 of 125 cases; Vidio or Peñas was clear in just 1 of 125.

historicalFindings.title: Height helps only in a narrow regime
historicalFindings.headline: 54.3% any ridge · 100% any south point · n=35
historicalFindings.detail: Under the strict shallow-low-cloud signature, at least one of four sampled ridges was clear in 19 of 35 cases, but all four failed in 16. At least one south-plain point was clear in all 35. This small conditional sample is directional, not a site forecast.

historicalFindings.title: High ground is not a generic upgrade
historicalFindings.headline: Soto 37.7% · sampled ridges 18.3–37.2%
historicalFindings.detail: Leitariegos roughly matched Soto, while La Cubilla, San Isidro and Fuente Dé were historically worse. Coast clear while every sampled ridge was not clear occurred in 71 of 600 cases.

trafficModel.name: Conditional route-pressure triage
trafficModel.question: How fragile is this route if this branch is chosen and nominally open?
trafficModel.notAnswered: This model does not predict an eclipse-day ETA, queue length, parking availability or the probability that a weather branch will be chosen.
trafficModel.scoreFormula: round_to_5(100 / 3 × (0.10 resident + 0.15 tourism + 0.15 magnet + 0.10 seasonal_load + 0.20 fragility + 0.10 overlap + 0.15 parking + 0.05 controls))
trafficModel.componentScale: Each component is scored 0–3; every component and imputation is published on the route card.

fragility: dead-end, mountain pass or constrained tunnel

hardOverrides: Unconfirmed legal parking at an unmanaged site: NO_GO_BY_CAR
Shuttle-only site with no confirmed service: NO_GO
DGT publication older than 15 minutes: UNKNOWN, never clear
scenarioModifiers: One widely promoted clear slot: raise one pressure band
West/east reversal after commitment: raise one pressure band
Already safely pre-positioned: lower one pressure band
Hard overrides still outrank every band

capacityStressAssumptions.description: Where the official people capacity is complete, the card shows a vehicle-demand stress interval. It is not an attendance forecast.

routes.name: Los Quebrantos
routes.roadLabel: Soto town centre → SB-3 beach approach
routes.populationArea: Soto del Barco + Muros de Nalón
routes.parking: Official API count absent; walking/shuttle corridor announced

conditionalDisruption.label: Guarded exposure
conditionalDisruption.condition: chosen by foot or confirmed shuttle

routes.override: Driving to the beach without a managed parking instruction raises the branch to high and can block the local plan.
routes.action: Walk or use the announced shuttle; be staged by 16:00; retain the later return plan.

routes.name: Cabo Vidio
routes.roadLabel: N-632 / A-8 shared trunk → CU-8 / local last mile
routes.override: Reject if a legal final access/parking plan remains unpublished.
routes.action: Lock west by 14:00, choose one destination and never reverse east.

routes.name: Caroyas
routes.roadLabel: A-8 shared trunk → local final access
routes.override: People capacity is not car capacity; without directed legal parking this remains low-confidence.
routes.action: Use as the same-side west backup only; do not turn it into a second chase.

routes.name: El Espartal

conditionalDisruption.label: High exposure
conditionalDisruption.condition: chosen by car and nominally open

routes.override: The saved route is mainly N-632, not an assumed A-8 east route; recompute on the day.
routes.action: Arrive early, keep an urban abort point and never continue to an iconic headland after the gate.

routes.name: Xagó
routes.parking: Special shuttle announced; throughput and road-parking count unpublished

conditionalDisruption.label: High by shuttle · severe by car

routes.override: Driving adds herding and parking exposure, raising this route one band to severe.
routes.action: Use only with a confirmed boarding point and timetable; never infer beach parking.

routes.name: Casa El Puerto, Tineo

conditionalDisruption.label: High exposure
conditionalDisruption.condition: selected above a verified shallow deck

routes.override: A widely promoted shallow-deck winner raises this route one band to severe.
routes.action: Move only after cloud-top, upper-layer and ridge gates pass; require a managed standing/parking area.

routes.name: Alto de la Farrapona
routes.roadLabel: Long Somiedo approach → AS-227 / dead-end mountain road
routes.parking: Shuttle announced; eclipse return details remain a hard gate
routes.override: Already being safely pre-positioned lowers exposure one band, but never converts Farrapona into a day-of chase.
routes.action: Use only if already positioned, return transport is confirmed and the shallow-deck geometry is directly proven.

routes.name: Sotres / La Caballar
routes.roadLabel: Long A-8 / AS-114 approach → constrained Picos road
routes.override: NO_GO as a reactive Soto branch; small capacity and high tourist intensity do not create resilience.
routes.action: Remove from the day-of option set. It is a separately pre-positioned destination only.

routes.name: AP-66 to León / Palacio ESA
routes.roadLabel: A-8 → A-66 / AP-66 shared trunk → urban endpoint
routes.parking: Venue reports about 400 spaces; event capacity unpublished

conditionalDisruption.label: Severe crossing · critical drive-up
conditionalDisruption.condition: route nominally open; mode and endpoint dependent

routes.override: DGT records checked 30 July show AP-66 lane/carriageway controls through 31 August. Re-clear record-level status on 12 August.
routes.action: Decide by 11:00–12:00, cross once, use a confirmed endpoint and never treat N-630 as an automatic bypass.

routes.name: Villadangos plain concept
routes.mode: No-go by car until legal parcel exists
routes.roadLabel: A-8 → A-66 / AP-66 shared trunk → exact endpoint unresolved
routes.parking: No precise legal managed parcel confirmed

conditionalDisruption.label: High only with a legal parcel

routes.override: NO_GO_BY_CAR while the endpoint is only a geographic concept.
routes.action: Name and verify a legal arrival/parking parcel by 11 August or delete this option.

scenarios.title: Local coast clear or lightly cloudy

probability.label: 37.7% historical
probability.detail: 226 of 600 Soto-cell cases at 18:00 UTC

scenarios.trigger: Forecast, three satellite frames and the direct 280° up-sun view agree.
scenarios.action: Use Los Quebrantos by foot or confirmed shuttle.
scenarios.mitigation: Keep Espíritu Santo as the same local corridor backup.
scenarios.hardStop: Do not enter a closed promenade/dune sector or drive without managed parking.

scenarios.title: Stable west-or-east coastal gap

probability.label: Live-only
probability.detail: Joint rate for an actionable broad gap is unavailable

scenarios.trigger: A broad same-direction gap persists in three consecutive 10-minute frames and direct/camera evidence agrees.
scenarios.action: Select west or east once.
scenarios.mitigation: Keep one same-side backup and freeze the direction.
scenarios.hardStop: Never reverse across the corridor after commitment.

scenarios.title: Overcast Soto, illusory coastal escape

probability.label: 20.8% Soto overcast
probability.detail: 125 of 600; any other sampled coast clear in 8.0%, nearby pair in 0.8%

scenarios.trigger: Broad overcast covers Soto and the supposed coastal gap lacks three-frame confirmation.
scenarios.action: Reject coast roulette; hold the safe local plan or execute an already-selected south plan.
scenarios.mitigation: Use the regime boundary, not one clear model pixel.
scenarios.hardStop: No sequential beach hopping.

scenarios.title: Shallow deck with a viable height rung

probability.label: 5.8% strict signature
probability.detail: 35 of 600; any sampled ridge clear in 54.3%

scenarios.trigger: Cloud top is at least 200 m below the exact site, middle/high layers are clear and the ridge is directly observed clear.
scenarios.action: Use the measured height ladder, led by Casa El Puerto.
scenarios.mitigation: Prefer an intermediate rung before a narrow high-mountain road.
scenarios.hardStop: A ceiling reports cloud base, not top.

scenarios.title: High ridge embedded or worse than the coast

probability.label: Material historical failure
probability.detail: Ridge clear/light baseline 18.3–37.2%; all four ridges failed in 45.7% of strict-low cases

scenarios.trigger: Ridge cap, spillover, upper cloud or an unverified cloud top remains.
scenarios.action: Reject the climb and use the safest confirmed lower branch.
scenarios.mitigation: Check a ridge camera/direct view before leaving the trunk road.
scenarios.hardStop: Picos elevation is never a generic cloud fallback.

scenarios.title: South clear while Soto is overcast

probability.label: 38.4–49.6% per south point
probability.detail: Conditional on 125 Soto-overcast cases

scenarios.trigger: Observed and multi-model south advantage persists; AP-66 and an exact legal endpoint pass.
scenarios.action: Cross once, early.
scenarios.mitigation: Prefer pre-positioning or transit at the endpoint.
scenarios.hardStop: No precise legal endpoint means no south branch.

scenarios.title: South advantage during a shallow local deck

probability.label: 68.6–91.4% per south point
probability.detail: Conditional on only 35 strict-low cases; any south point clear in 35 of 35

scenarios.trigger: Morning evidence shows a persistent south regime before the height branch can be directly proven.
scenarios.action: Prefer the executable early south branch.
scenarios.mitigation: Choose height only when it is directly proven and operationally safer.
scenarios.hardStop: Do not wait for a better mountain nowcast past the south gate.

scenarios.title: Middle or high cloud blankets both sides

probability.label: Plausible; uncalibrated
probability.detail: No defensible joint historical rate in the current evidence cut

scenarios.trigger: Upper-layer cloud is widespread across the north, ridges and south plain.
scenarios.action: Stop chasing and use the safest confirmed managed site.
scenarios.mitigation: Optimize safety, horizon and group experience rather than distance.
scenarios.hardStop: Altitude cannot fix middle/high cloud.
scenarios.deadline: As soon as the regional regime is established

scenarios.title: Coastal edge collapses after commitment

probability.label: Plausible; uncalibrated
probability.detail: Cloud-edge lifetime is not forecastable at route scale

scenarios.trigger: The selected gap closes after the route or movement gate has expired.
scenarios.action: Hold the chosen managed area.
scenarios.mitigation: Allow only a safe walk-scale adjustment with a verified WNW view.
scenarios.hardStop: No regional relocation after 16:00; stop all new movement after 18:00.

scenarios.title: Wind, rain or mountain cap at an exposed site

probability.label: Unlikely to plausible
probability.detail: Live-controlled seasonal hazard; no calibrated event rate

scenarios.trigger: Wind limits, rain, lightning risk, lift cancellation or direct ridge-cap observation.
scenarios.action: Use the preselected lower managed option.
scenarios.mitigation: Confirm lift/shuttle wind policies and carry layers before departure.
scenarios.hardStop: No exposed ridge or lift when the operator or safety gate fails.

scenarios.title: Shared coastal corridor saturation

probability.label: Likely exposure
probability.detail: Structured judgment; western A-8 August counts already exceed annual average, while east routes also converge on N-632/Avilés

scenarios.trigger: DGT/cameras show slowing or cloud guidance sends demand into one coastal sector.
scenarios.action: Freeze west/east early and retain only a same-side backup.
scenarios.mitigation: Use route-specific road references; do not hardcode every east move as A-8.
scenarios.hardStop: No west/east reversal.

scenarios.title: AP-66 / Negrón disruption

probability.label: Reduced resilience is known
probability.detail: DGT snapshot on 30 July contains lane/carriageway management through 31 August; exact eclipse-day state remains live-only

scenarios.trigger: Fresh DGT records, cameras or 112 show a closure, unstable flow or controls incompatible with the south deadline.
scenarios.action: Remove every south option that depends on the shared trunk.
scenarios.mitigation: Recheck record-level start/end and direction in the morning.
scenarios.hardStop: N-630 is not an automatic fallback.

scenarios.title: Single-road last-mile gridlock

probability.label: Likely at fragile sites
probability.detail: Uncalibrated; constrained headland, beach and ridge approaches share this failure mode

scenarios.trigger: Queue reaches the last safe abort point or emergency access is compromised.
scenarios.action: Abort to the preselected same-side managed option.
scenarios.mitigation: Prefer shuttle/pre-positioning; identify the abort point before departure.
scenarios.hardStop: Never queue or park on a shoulder, emergency lane, track or dry field.

scenarios.title: Parking and shuttle supply mismatch

probability.label: Supply is currently unknown
probability.detail: The official 78-site feed has zero populated parking fields; people capacity is not vehicle capacity

scenarios.trigger: No exact parking count, boarding point, seats/hour or return plan can be verified.
scenarios.action: Mark the route UNKNOWN or NO_GO_BY_CAR.
scenarios.mitigation: Show the missing supply input next to every ordinal pressure band.
scenarios.hardStop: Never convert official people capacity into available car spaces.

scenarios.title: Forecast-induced herding to one winner

probability.label: Plausible to likely
probability.detail: Uncalibrated; DGT itself flags the difficulty of predicting trending locations

scenarios.trigger: Multiple public channels converge on the same site or clear slot.
scenarios.action: Raise that route one pressure band and prefer a managed same-regime alternative.
scenarios.mitigation: Publish branches and hard gates, not one universal winning pin.
scenarios.hardStop: Do not chase social-media popularity.

scenarios.title: Synchronized dusk exodus

probability.label: High exposure; no calibrated rate
probability.detail: DGT expects arrivals to be staggered and departures more concentrated; no evidence supports a numeric interval

scenarios.trigger: Totality ends and a mass departure begins in dusk.
scenarios.action: Follow managed sequencing and delay departure until the immediate surge visibly eases.
scenarios.mitigation: Set a lit meeting point, pedestrian plan and later return before the eclipse.
scenarios.hardStop: No competitive immediate exit.

scenarios.title: Soto promenade or rockfall closure

probability.label: Current unresolved blocker
probability.detail: A closure notice exists; the exact eclipse-day sector/reopening remains unverified

scenarios.trigger: Council or on-site control confirms the intended approach is closed.
scenarios.action: Switch to confirmed Espíritu Santo / shuttle access.
scenarios.mitigation: Scout the exact walking line before 8 August and recheck same-day.
scenarios.hardStop: Never bypass a rockfall closure.
scenarios.deadline: Before leaving the local staging point

scenarios.title: Fire-risk or dry-field prohibition

probability.label: Seasonal; live-controlled
probability.detail: No calibrated site rate; legal restrictions can change daily

scenarios.trigger: IRIF, INFOPA, municipal order or express signage restricts the site or access.
scenarios.action: Remove the site immediately.
scenarios.mitigation: Maintain one managed paved alternative in each executable branch.
scenarios.hardStop: No tracks, verges, forest access or dry agricultural fields.

scenarios.title: Protected-area or shuttle-only access

probability.label: Certain for affected sites
probability.detail: This is a rule state, not an event probability

scenarios.trigger: The chosen site requires official transport, reservation or protected-area controls.
scenarios.action: Use the official service or exclude the destination from reactive choices.
scenarios.mitigation: Record boarding point, last return and accessibility before selection.
scenarios.hardStop: No improvised drive-up overflow.

scenarios.title: Lift or shuttle cancelled

probability.label: Plausible; uncalibrated
probability.detail: Wind, capacity and timetable can all remove the service

scenarios.trigger: Operator confirmation is missing, outbound service is full, return is before totality or wind policy closes it.
scenarios.action: Use the lower managed branch.
scenarios.mitigation: Confirm both outbound and return legs, not just a generic shuttle announcement.
scenarios.hardStop: Farrapona remains pre-position-only; rejected lift pins remain rejected.

scenarios.title: South destination unconfirmed or saturated

probability.label: Currently unresolved
probability.detail: Villadangos has no precise legal parcel; the free ESA event has unpublished capacity

scenarios.trigger: No exact legal arrival point, parking/transport plan or capacity path can be confirmed.
scenarios.action: Delete the south branch from the executable plan.
scenarios.mitigation: Secure one legal managed endpoint by 11 August or pre-position by transit.
scenarios.hardStop: A geographic plain is not a parking instruction.
scenarios.deadline: 11 August; recheck before 11:00 on eclipse day

scenarios.title: Decision deadlock or late reversal

probability.label: Plausible to likely
probability.detail: Uncalibrated group-execution risk

scenarios.trigger: The group reopens a branch after its decision deadline.
scenarios.action: One named decision owner applies the printed gates.
scenarios.mitigation: Agree beforehand that a passed gate is irreversible except for a safety veto.
scenarios.hardStop: No consensus-by-car and no mid-route reversal.

scenarios.title: Group separation or network overload

probability.label: Plausible
probability.detail: Uncalibrated crowd and mobile-network risk

scenarios.trigger: Messages fail, a member misses the shuttle or the group loses visual contact.
scenarios.action: Use the fixed meeting point and wait rule.
scenarios.mitigation: Carry paper contacts, offline maps and a shared fallback timetable.
scenarios.hardStop: No member starts an uncoordinated road move.

scenarios.title: Heat, fatigue, medication or mobility failure

probability.label: Plausible
probability.detail: Uncalibrated; exposure rises with queues, walking and late return

scenarios.trigger: Water, shade, medicine, accessibility or safe return becomes uncertain.
scenarios.action: Stop movement before urgency develops and use the accessible managed option.
scenarios.mitigation: Carry water, layers, medication, seats and a return-light plan.
scenarios.hardStop: Weather advantage never outranks health capability.

scenarios.title: Missing or damaged eclipse glasses

probability.label: Unlikely to plausible
probability.detail: Preventable equipment failure; uncalibrated

scenarios.trigger: A filter is missing, scratched, punctured or of uncertain provenance.
scenarios.action: Use a reputable certified spare or do not view the partial phases directly.
scenarios.mitigation: Pack separate spares and brief filter-off/filter-on timing.
scenarios.hardStop: Filters come off only during complete totality and return at the first bright solar surface.

scenarios.title: Weather API stale, unavailable or wrong target time

probability.label: Plausible
probability.detail: Uncalibrated provider and integration risk

scenarios.trigger: Fetch age exceeds 15 minutes in the operational window, target time is not 20:27 CEST or variables are missing.
scenarios.action: Fail closed and open the official AEMET sources.
scenarios.mitigation: Show source, fetch time, valid time and stale state next to every value.
scenarios.hardStop: Never substitute climatology or null-as-zero.

scenarios.title: Empty DGT feed creates false reassurance

probability.label: Plausible to likely
probability.detail: Feeds report situations, not proof of uncongested flow

scenarios.trigger: Zero route matches, stale publication, parser error or camera/feed disagreement.
scenarios.action: Show UNKNOWN and cross-check 112, cameras and official controls.
scenarios.mitigation: Match every situation record to road references before truncating the display.
scenarios.hardStop: No incidents never means route clear.

scenarios.title: Models disagree or flip between runs

probability.label: Likely before nowcast
probability.detail: At D-13, current ECMWF and GFS ensembles already disagree sharply on the Picos/ridge outcome

scenarios.trigger: Ensemble probabilities, deterministic points or consecutive cycles disagree on the branch.
scenarios.action: Hold all branches until regime-scale consensus and observations emerge.
scenarios.mitigation: Compare ensembles and consecutive cycles; weight satellite/direct evidence on the day.
scenarios.hardStop: Do not rank from one Best Match pixel or one run.
scenarios.deadline: Long range: planning only; operational from D-4

scenarios.title: GPS, battery, clock or saved-gate failure

probability.label: Plausible
probability.detail: Uncalibrated device failure

scenarios.trigger: Power, mobile data, local storage, navigation or time zone fails.
scenarios.action: Use the printed route and manual deadline card.
scenarios.mitigation: Carry power, offline maps and one independent clock.
scenarios.hardStop: Device state is never the sole authority for a move.

scenarios.title: DEM or pin differs from the real standing point

probability.label: Known limitation
probability.detail: Terrain screens omit trees/buildings and current Coto Bello/Cuitunigru pins are unresolved

scenarios.trigger: The exact 279.5–282.5° sightline has not been scouted or the official observation polygon differs from the input pin.
scenarios.action: Use the IGN viewer and field-check the exact standing area.
scenarios.mitigation: Keep coordinate-sensitive pins rejected until corrected.
scenarios.hardStop: A high site with a blocked WNW horizon is no site at all.
